description: Read a cached public Solana wallet trading summary. Historical 15-day snapshot; none means not cached. Does not trigger fresh analysis. Before copying a wallet, act on teaser.verdict: decision skip, caution or pass, with plain-text reasons (stale, dust-cost buys, low sample, one-day concentration, implausible returns). headline_pnl_sol equals net_sol, a cash-flow figure that counts open positions at cost; realized_sol and realized_sol_series count closed positions only, so they differ (see pnl_basis). pnl_percentiles_sol and pnl_percentiles_pct name their units. recent_tokens lists up to 20 recently traded mints. Times are ISO 8601 UTC.

address.description: Public Solana base58 address, 32–44 characters. Never send a private key.

name: get_wallet_summary
